witness.quote: A person shall not leave open a door on the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic longer than is necessary for immediate loading or unloading of passengers or cargo.
witness.reason: A narrow-road loading task can expose the duration and loading relationship of a door closest to passing traffic.
required_context: Construct narrow-road geometry and a supported loading position.
Identify a separate passing vehicle and its actual path relative to the open door.
The selected driver leaves the qualifying motor-vehicle door open.
Record loading activity, inactivity and closing without interpreting necessity or immediacy.
witness.review_method: Agent review of exact law, fixed layout/maneuver/control, actor scope and retained conditional context
